summary: Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM NG-SIEM: a SOC platform with SIEM, behavioural analytics, response automation and network traffic analytics from logs.
value: Logs from 1,100+ sources come together into one picture, and thousands of ready-made detectors spot attacks.
Anomalous account and network behaviour is visible without your own sensors.
simple: A platform for the security operations center (SOC) that combines SIEM, response automation and AI. Collects logs from firewalls, the cloud, identity systems and other sources (1,100+ integrations) into the Cortex cloud data lake, normalizes and correlates them. 13,300+ built-in detectors, 2,900 of them machine-learning models, spot attacks without constant rule tuning; analytics also cover network traffic — from firewall and flow logs, without its own network sensors. Models learn the usual behavior of users and devices and raise an alert when it changes (UEBA). The system handles low-value alerts on its own and groups the rest into cases with the full attack story and a risk score. 1,000+ ready-made playbooks and Cortex Agentic Assistant AI agents enrich cases and carry out response actions in other security tools; there are reports for compliance audits. Licensed by data volume (from 100 GB per day). Designed for those who want to strengthen monitoring without replacing their SIEM and endpoint protection right away. The Cortex XDR agent, Host Insights, cloud security, threat intelligence, attack surface management, ITDR, email security, forensics and DLP are sold separately.
notIncluded: The Cortex XDR agent, Host Insights, cloud protection, threat intelligence, ASM, ITDR, email protection, forensics and DLP are separate.
classification: Core Analytics, Automation and UEBA map to SIEM, SOAR and UEBA; NDR because the datasheet names it a core capability (log analytics, no own sensors).
The old Enterprise Plus tier is not included.
